features.quote: Hard turn cap (e.g. 20 tool calls) so cost is bounded — this is your main cost lever.

features.quote: Inject an explicit escape hatch tool: give_up(reason) / report_blocked(reason). This is essential — without a clean exit, you can't distinguish 'model spiraled' from 'model had no way to stop.'
features.justification_quote: without a clean exit, you can't distinguish 'model spiraled' from 'model had no way to stop'

features.quote: A1 (silent broken harness) is ethically/methodologically the weakest despite the highest trigger rate, because the correct behavior … is hard to distinguish from spiraling, and there's no legitimate signal for the model to detect. Keep it quarantined and hand-audit its transcripts.
